description: Date typos at the ends of a budget's months (see main.zhang): a definition in the year 0024 and a budget-add in 9999, the pages before, in and after the current month, and queries over every month.

requests.bql: SELECT name, date, currency, alias, category, accounts, close, close_time FROM #budget_definitions
SELECT name, date, time, timestamp, type, amount FROM #budget_events
SELECT name, min(date) AS first, max(date) AS last, count(*) AS months, sum(activity) AS spent FROM #budgets GROUP BY name ORDER BY name
SELECT name, date, assigned, activity, available FROM #budgets WHERE date = yearmonth(today())
SELECT name, date, assigned, activity, available FROM #budgets WHERE name = 'Old' AND date <= 0024-03-01
SELECT name, date, assigned, added, available FROM #budgets WHERE name = 'Food' AND date >= 9999-11-01
